task: Fastify Presentation Server (Port 3003), Luminous Knowledge HUD & Master Independent Verification (EP 12)

features: Fastify v5 presentation server strictly binding to port 3003 with @fastify/cors and unconditional @fastify/static registration
GET /health: healthcheck endpoint returning status HEALTHY, port 3003, and uptime
GET /knowledge/hud: serves Luminous Knowledge HUD HTML interface
GET /api/v1/knowledge/search: executes hybrid, dense, and sparse search with RRF k=60 and MMR reranking, returning rrfScore, denseRank, sparseRank
POST /api/v1/knowledge/ingest: parses, chunks, embeds, and indexes document into BM25 and HNSW, returning chunks with breadcrumbs and line numbers
GET /api/v1/knowledge/metrics: telemetry metrics for vault, indices, query throughput, and memory RSS
GET /api/v1/knowledge/vector-projection: 2D harmonic projection of 384D vectors with cluster markers for HTML5 canvas
GET /api/v1/knowledge/stream: high-frequency 10Hz Server-Sent Events (SSE) telemetry feed with safe write handlers and clean client tracking
POST /api/v1/knowledge/grounding/audit: real-time grounding verification against contextChunks or auto-resolved SQLite chunks
100% compliant with Luminous Light Theme Invariant (Canvas Warm Paper #FAF9F6, Cards #FFFFFF, luminous optical borders, inset highlights, zero dark theme violations)
12-column Bento Grid Layout:
- Module 1: 2D Vector Space Projection Canvas (60 FPS animated photon stream, dense/sparse clusters, interactive node click prefill)
- Module 2: Live Query Tester (parallel comparison of RRF vs Dense vs Sparse, quick sample chips, copy citation buttons)
- Module 3: Document Ingestion Dropzone & Chunk Inspector (interactive Drag-and-Drop zone, file picker, real breadcrumbs tree with line numbers)
- Module 4: Grounding & Citation Audit Ledger (live Grounded Faithfulness Score Gauge, claim audit verification, dynamic ledger appending)
WebAudioHaptics: tactile acoustic feedback for clicks, ingestion, search ping, citation verification, and smart refusal
Real-time 10Hz SSE stream ingestion updating telemetry badges live
40 independent master assertions across EP 09, EP 10, EP 11, and EP 12 (100% PASS)
Strict verification of port 3003 binding without permissive fallbacks
Verification of @fastify/static file serving under /static/
Strict zero-dark-theme audit on HUD HTML tokens including tooltips
Comprehensive scorecard output with execution durations and status
